channel_1_vmo_partial_burning_ejecta.note: NSE-freezeout / incomplete-burning enrichment of the ejected envelope (WFH67; FWW86).  Transport is bulk ejection — the E_Y>0 channel helium already requires; metals stay sequestered in the temporal-well remnant, removing the Carr-Bond-Arnett objection that killed the channel in steady-state history.  Required transit fraction 0.051-1.02 of astrated mass vs the envelope-ejection fraction the f_VMO=0.994 IMF already supplies.
channel_1_vmo_partial_burning_ejecta.status: viable within documented yield range — reduces item d1 to the VMO envelope ejecta-fraction/enrichment calculation (stellar-structure input, not new transport physics)

channel_2_vmo_collapse_nu_process.note: FWW86 / Fuller & Shi 1997: thermal nubar_e from the homologously collapsing core drive nubar_e+p -> n+e+ in the envelope; n(p,gamma)D enrichment documented to D/H ~ 1e-4 in ejecta.  Neutrinos are standard-model matter on g~ (A2): MeV neutrinos propagate near-null, sharing the photon cone modulo the multi-messenger-bounded disformal term; the Z_max confinement bound applies to non-relativistic escape, not the transient burst.  Irradiation is required only core -> envelope during collapse (lapse ~ O(1), pre-well); post-formation interior emission emerges below the 1.8 MeV capture threshold, which merely terminates an already-operated channel.
channel_2_vmo_collapse_nu_process.status: viable — yield documented and transport fixed by A2 for the transient phase (near-null neutrinos on g~, irradiation at lapse ~ O(1) before well formation); residual task is a quantitative irradiation budget on the TEP-BH collapse solution, not a transport derivation

channel_3_protected_reservoir.mechanism: On bounded-astration-exposure worldlines (p + q = 1.3 > 1 convergence, Gate 11C) the D destruction term is bounded while production time is unbounded: even GCR-rate spallation accumulates X_D,res = 1.7e-7 x N_exp over N_exp exposure-equivalents.  Mixing f_mix X_D,res = 2.04e-5 closes the ledger.
channel_3_protected_reservoir.signature: metal-poor reservoirs with super-ISM D/H — an observable, discordant-D/H population is a specific prediction and is also the signature Fuller & Shi 1997 assigned to supermassive-star ejecta masquerading as Lyman-limit systems
channel_3_protected_reservoir.status: viable in rate terms for N_exp >~ 1e3 exposure equivalents with f_mix ~ 1-12%; the binding input is reservoir longevity/disruption, a mixing calculation rather than new microphysics

channel_4_wind_shock_bookkeeping.status: energetically marginal at fiducial parameters — requires order-unity conversion of wind kinetic energy into >30 MeV particles at the low-mass end; subsumed by channel 1, retained as the most conservative bound

verdict: Two pre-sequestration channels close the Gate-13 shortfall within documented yield ranges: (1) VMO partial-burning/explosive-freezeout ejecta carry the documented enrichment X_D ~ 2e-5-4e-4, needing only f ~ 0.05-1.0 of astrated mass to transit the ejecta — a fraction the envelope-ejection geometry of the helium channel already supplies; the Carr-Bond-Arnett metal objection is removed by the temporal-horizon sequestration the model is built on.  (3) Bounded-exposure worldlines accumulate D without a destruction term and mix it in, closing the ledger for N_exp >~ 1e3 at f_mix ~ 1-12%, with a falsifiable signature (metal-poor high-D reservoirs).  The collapse neutrino process (2) reaches the same ejecta enrichment per FWW86/FS97; its transport leg is fixed by Axiom A2 for the transient phase — MeV neutrinos are near-null matter on g~, irradiating the envelope while the lapse is still order unity, before the temporal well forms (the Z_max confinement bound applies to non-relativistic escape, not to the burst).  Item d1 therefore stands as: documented channels exist whose viability reduces to two compute tasks — the VMO ejecta-fraction/enrichment calculation and the reservoir mixing rate — plus a quantitative neutrino irradiation budget on the TEP-BH collapse solution.
